items.headline: Holders ~17% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.83: price is 17% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.479). Yet 55% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: -83% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 15th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 48 while the rest average 19 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 48/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.83 = 5th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.83 sits at the 5th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 5th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: -85% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.6; price sits -85% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 27,185 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,368 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-17.0% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.74M SPX. 4w -3.2% · 12w -17% · 26w -21.9%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-17.0% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.note: A position read, not a signal.
